notes.title: OWW: 1.1 - ‘Hello world’ - Break all the rules update!
notes.notes:
[b]OWW: 1.1 - ‘Hello world’[/b]
Someone once said:"Great things are done by a series of small things brought together." That someone was Van Gogh. While not being a game developer he describes the creative process very well. 

Hello Artinauts!
We’ve been so busy we forgot to actually tell the world about our recent updates(!) and all the things we added/fixed in the past 12 months. We may be silent and introverted but rest assured we are nowhere near done with the Artiverse. So please accept our apologies and check out these cool new features in the game!  

PS
Ever wanted to show one of your artworks on a phone because you didn’t have a gaming PC nearby? Well... Did you know you can use your OWW account on KULTURA.art? It’s a web/mobile interface that gives you access to your in game art collection, comments and notifications + some special features. It also has DAISY and art collected on KULTURA will show up in your OWW account. Give it a go…

[b]Broke all the rules:
[/b]
[list] 
[*] Expansions removed - no limits, run free :) 
[*] New FreeForm rotation method with holding mouse button - 360 degrees of freedom - hold left mouse button and move the mouse. 
[*] Ability to reset a gallery - ever wanted to nuke a gallery? Start fresh? Please be careful with the red button (you can find it in the main menu on your gallery list)
[*] Carpets to set spawn points in your gallery - those innocent (‘welcome’) carpets are connected to GPS satellites and allow you to set visitor spawn points if precise targeting. 
[*] Complexity meter - showing the expected performance of your gallery - if you care about those things. 
[*] Stickers! Customise your space even more (we didn’t think it was possible but hey :) 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33229108/6e2b5d1d5bf10e5c4e991c11003a1b21c835ad31.png[/img]

[b]Improvements and optimizations:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Dramatic performance optimization (we did a lot), tons of it - Loading performance, graphics, UNREAL engine updates, tons of assets optimised, networking, replication, rendering etc. 
[*] New main menu UI - a fresh coat of paint (and some ceramic coating!) never hurts.
[*] Your game account is now synced with the website (KULTURA.art) - you can log in with the same credentials, and it's perhaps easier to review your collection on a more convenient website. Ability to like art in game (replacing wishlist)
[*] New cursor (!!) looks much better now. 
[*] Arrow assets now can be mirrored - so three lefts make a right now :) 
[*] Localization updates
[*] Change the building distance (asset placing) - with a mouse wheel scroll 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33229108/179f1aa0bf711465db206a1234f835ad64997618.jpg[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Music volume balance on loading
[*] Artefacts on building/deleting assets effects
[*] Fixed avatars having wrong material
[*] Head bobbing finally removed (yay!) 
[*] Economy problems (wrong income, NPCs not leaving cubes, incorrect charge for buying assets), now sorted. 
[*] Login and registration problems - fixed! 
[*] Fixed galleries search bar working incorrectly when gallery name has special symbols
[*] Fixed Environment tool not working when you are far away from the starting position 
[*] Fixed free camera not showing your own avatar
[*] Fixed artwork preview in inventory not showing some info
[*] UI could get unresponsive after viewing user profile - fixed
[*] Fixed avatar visibility bug when switching between first person and third person 
[*] Fixed bugs with Portals (not being able to set destination, portal UI not opening in some cases)
[*] Fixed bugs with granting building permissions
[*] Fixed water shader producing artefacts on some graphic cards
[*] Fixed how long usernames appear to fit some narrow UI holders
[*] Fixed visual bugs for mirrored assets
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33229108/4470ec8c21199727449e456281caddb23d51c4d1.jpg[/img]

[b]New Assets: [/b]
[list]
[*] 44 Stickers
[*] New trails effect  masks
[*] 71 new frames
[*] “Invisible neon” walls, floor and ceiling
[*] New assets available at Dealers in Piazza
[*] tons of new assets in the pipeline, stay tuned 
[/list]


Stay tuned for even more exciting news, SOON™

KULTURA Ex Machina
London, June 2023

notes.title: OWW: 9.8 CloudSound update!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=YqwGU2rkilg;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello players and robots, 
Us Pixels have been busy working on a huge update that we are very proud to announce today. We have more cool features in the oven, stay tuned. 

[h2]New:[/h2]
[list]
[h3]CloudSound[/h3]  
[b]Add music from SoundCloud to your gallery[/b]
[*] 2 unique speakers, 2 Jukeboxes, and a turntable to choose from
[*] 4 different animation effects
[*] Load songs from SoundCloud to anywhere in your gallery
[*] Choose the radius distance of the music
[*] Let visitors hear your music all over your gallery with the global setting
[*] Place multiple speakers and only hear only closest (great for specific rooms)
[h3]Grid Snapping[/h3] 
[b]Perfectly align art and objects[/b]
[*] 6 different grid snap sizes
[*] Enable/disable snapping using the checkbox on the left
[*] Select the Grid Rotation option to snap to the default grid
[h3]New Piazza Dei Miracoli[/h3] 
[b]Formally known as Plaza, this new Piazza is unlike anything you have seen before[/b]
[*] New starting zone
[*] Take a walk with nature, even into the ocean, dynamic day/night sky
[*] An easter egg, or two
[*] Build an exhibit in one of the 16 large rooms
[*] Mysterious vortex (New feature coming soon)
[h3]Zero Gallery[/h3]
[*] New starting gallery
[*] 33 new assets, including ladders and stone paths! (search 'zero' in inventory)
[h3]Mouse unlock[/h3]

[*] Use F to unlock/lock mouse, faster deleting, building, etc
[*] Ability to interact with the UI using the mouse

notes.title: OWW v5.0.2 Deep State Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33229108/22ffc52cfd1691e41641bcb0b14a6bdc3f9eb771.jpg[/img]

For this update ‘The Stikipixels’ went deep underground, under DAISY’s skin, beneath miles of fiber optics, quantum mechanics and fast food wrappings. No stone is left unturned, you won’t believe the junk we found but we cleared it all out - you’re not an indie gamedev until you haul dead rats from behind a server! 

The result? Lots of new art found, lots of bugs too but hail DAISY, they were fixed. 
The artiverse now runs faster, cleaner and brighter than ever (seriously, check out the skyboxes!). 

Ready or not,  

[h1]Welcome to OWW, 5.0.2 Deep State awaits you![/h1]
[b]New Features/Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Brand new chat, a flexible system ready to become your new home, including emojis and the ability to link artworks and galleries! We also added a few more channels ... we might add another ten as we go along … 
[*] New deep state asset sets for those who love interrogation rooms, endless filing cabinets, surveillance and recording studios. 
[*] Vases for all … possibly.     
[*] Did you ever want really dirty bricks? Well, we present you with an extremely weathered set of bricks. In general, we are adding dirt whenever and wherever we can. 
[*] Upgraded bamboo sofas … with silly attention to detail.  
[*] Concept art extravaganza, our concept art team has been hard at work creating tons of asset and accessory concepts. 
[*] Added floor grid to space skyboxes
[*] New plaza and tutorial area
[/list]
[previewyoutube=28ybpM6XiwQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimizations, performance and stability improvements 
[*] Deep State art optimisations no1. We are trying to give you a few extra FPS, maybe 2 or 3.
[*] Skyboxes and lighting on steroids
[*] Better instructions and clearer error messages on registration
[/list]
[b]Fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] The ability to interact with objects through obstacles such as walls
[*] Various bugs with Cube Piles on desks
[*] Collisions for assets that couldn’t be placed [i](ADbench001_t-f, IDLight006B_t-c, IndLights002_t-c_Blueprint)[/i]

Stay awesome,

notes.title: Asset update 28/12 | This year in Occupy White Walls
notes.notes:
With 2018 drawing to a close we reflect on the year that has passed here at StikiPixels, and while for the world as a whole it might have been a turbulent one we can only say that for us it has brought us nothing but immense joy.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33229108/728ee5a40c6022bf522f7295c4e421a51353e498.gif[/img]

Some of you might not know that in early 2018 we opened up our (very) early alpha build and screamed into the void that is the internet that we were looking for people who are interested in art, architecture and building that we were searching for enthusiastic people interesting in testing our game. Needless to say we were happily surprised by the hordes of people interested in playing our game. 

Together with our amazing community we improved drastically upon the game to the point we felt like we were ready to take on Steam as an early access title. And ready we were! Unfortunately our servers weren’t, because as before we were surprised by the tens of thousands of people that have so far played our game and by extension melted our servers.

Some server upgrades, infrastructure changes, backend and game updates later the game already offers a lot more than it did at launch and we are still hard at work at creating exciting new ways to play the game.

[h1]New Stuff[/h1]
So before we go off and start preparing for the end of the holiday period we want to bring you another gift this season. Just so we can end the year on a high note we are releasing another 30 assets to the game. No update needed as we snuck in a few surprises with the last build.

Log in and you will find yourself with a bunch of new assets, and just like last week you will find these available across different levels and are using the opportunity to add these to levels some of you felt were a bit barren out of the feedback some of you provided us with last week.


New additions
At level 14: an expansion on the set”Rococo” 
At level 19: an expansion on the set “2055” 
At level 22: an entirely new set called “Mudejar” including a bunch of new walls we think you’ll really enjoy!
At level 25: Additional items added to the “Eindejaar” set, including new stairs
At level 30: Additional items added to “The End” set, including one of our awesome portals. 


From all of us here at StikiPixels we with you a happy new year and promise a lot more Occupy White Walls in 2019.

[i]PS. Time to use the holiday assets is running out. Any trees/ornaments placed in your gallery will remain but you will not be able to place new ones.[/i]

notes.title: Change log Early Access v1.1.0 | Tis the season to patch our game.
notes.notes:
T’is the season and with it comes a new update to your favourite game, this one’s pretty big and just filled with all sorts of presents. Get it? Because it’s the season? No? Okay then. 

We added some new levels for everyone with a new level cap of 30 and with it comes a lot of new assets. You can also expect some new holiday themed assets but get them while they’re still hot because once the season is over you will no longer find these available for building.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33229108/ba9aa1b2cc7312fc5fccbe166d93d180d48b6062.gif[/img]

[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the level cap from 20 to 30. Look out for questions about this in the near future.
[*] Style picker tool! Don’t want to look for that wall? Well just point at it with the new tool!
[*] Colored lights! (most of them can change colors now, anyway) 
[*] You can now mirror some assets with [F] (mainly stairs)
[*] Added brightness and hex color input to Text edit window.
[*] Colorised chat! Local messages shown in blue, Mods and Devs have a tag now

notes.title: Occupy White Walls Launch - Server Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Let’s start off by thanking everyone for playing our game! We did not anticipate the amount of traffic our game about art would recieve! 

As a result the servers were on fire and we functioned on coffee and cookies while searching for the error. But the good news is that our two biggest issues have been found and fixed.

No more will you teleport to the wrong gallery or have terrible connection issues. We also upgraded our servers to allows for the bigger load and removed a bottleneck in the server that caused our backend to come to a crawl.

So outside of the occasional disconnect that we are still working on the game should actually run like it was intended and we will back here soon to share more news about the future of our game!


Thank you for your patience and understanding,


- Marnick (Protobear)
